notes: Proposed RESCALEnew (denoted NEW; realized as NEW-IW, NEW-OS, NEW-US, NEW-NN, NEW-PETS, NEW-HE, NEW-SE) vs traditional rescaling OLD-* and cost-blind BLIND-*. Tables 3-23 report misclassification costs (BLIND absolute; OLD/NEW as ratio to BLIND, lower is better) on consistent (Tables 3,6,9,12,15,18,21) and inconsistent (Tables 4,7,10,13,16,19,22) cost matrices, with W/T/L summaries in Tables 5,8,11,14,17,20,23. NN/HE/SE exclude connect4 and splice; PETs excludes splice. Over-sampling (OLD-OS/NEW-OS) is cost-proportional duplication-based resampling, not SMOTE. SMOTE only cited (Chawla et al. 2002) in Section 4.4 motivation. Preliminary version: Zhou and Liu 2006a (AAAI).
